items.name: Lantern Leak
items.description: A glow brew that would not hold its light in. It leaks steadily, which ruins it as a lantern and makes it oddly useful for anyone who only needs to see for a minute.

effects.description: Casts a short-lived lantern aura.

items.name: Glow Potion
items.description: The first light most brewers manage. It is uneven, it does not last the night, and there is not a household on the north road that has not been grateful for one at some point.

effects.description: Bathes the drinker in a pale lantern aura.

items.name: Star Lantern Elixir
items.description: Luminous work done properly: a crystalline light that holds its brightness the whole way down instead of guttering out in the last hour like a cheaper pour.

effects.description: Creates a steadier lantern aura with little loss.
Sharpens movement through dark routes.

items.name: Beastcalm Extract
items.description: A quieting extract used to settle tower creatures and skittish magical fauna.

effects.description: Gives a soft halo that keeps habitats calm.

items.name: Splash Glow Potion
items.description: A glow brew opened outward into a quick halo. It lights everything at once and then stops, which is exactly right for finding a dropped thing and useless for anything else.

effects.description: Releases a wider lantern bloom on use.

items.name: Lantern Draught
items.description: A humble glow brew that keeps a road lamp honest through the early dark.

effects.description: Holds a steady working light for a short while.

items.name: Mothlight Brew
items.description: A soft, drifting glow gathered from settled moth dust, kind to night eyes.

effects.description: Casts a gentle, long-carrying light for night gathering.

items.name: Wardlight Solution
items.description: A cold arcane light meant to read faded wards and half-erased sigils.

effects.description: Throws a clear, revealing light across worn magical stone.

items.name: Runemark Elixir
items.description: A refined wardlight that makes old inscriptions surface as if freshly cut.

effects.description: Sustains a bright revealing glow across faded runework.

items.name: Duskbell Tonic
items.description: A calm, dim glow brewed to keep dusk-shy creatures settled while they are handled.

effects.description: Casts a soft halo that keeps nervous creatures calm.

items.name: Emberglass Tonic
items.description: A warm amber light hardened with quarry minerals, steady in wind and heat.

effects.description: Holds a warm, wind-resistant working light.

items.name: Stargrove Elixir
items.description: A layered luminous elixir that blends grove-cool and arcane light into one clear beam.

effects.description: Sustains a strong, clear light for deep or dark spaces.

items.name: Celestine Elixir
items.description: The observatory's own light: a crystalline glow that also sharpens the step beneath it.

effects.description: Creates a long, brilliant, near-lossless lantern aura.
Steadies and quickens movement through dark routes.

items.name: Sunscar Glass Elixir
items.description: Night bloom and noon resin held in one bottle: a light that carries desert heat without burning down.

effects.description: Throws a wide, warm light that shrugs off wind and cold alike.

items.name: Resonance Draught
items.description: Ward shard held in lantern dust. The light does not flicker, because the wards it came from do not either.

effects.description: Holds an even, unwavering light that will not gutter in wind or damp.
Steadies the footing of whoever carries it.

items.name: Forgelight Lantern
items.description: Emberglass driven with a kiln geode until the light stops being light and starts being heat you can see by.

effects.description: Casts a hot orange working light that holds in wind, rain and cold.
Takes the cold out of whoever is carrying it.

items.name: Beacon Burst
items.description: A lantern draught opened outward all at once. One bottle lights an entire crossroads for as long as it takes to decide which way you are going.

effects.description: Floods a wide area with light briefly rather than lighting your own step for long.

items.name: Nightwatch Lantern
items.description: Emberglass held back by a delay rune. It does nothing at all until you have stopped moving, and then it lights and keeps lighting.

effects.description: Comes up slowly and then holds far longer than an unworked lantern would.

items.name: Benchlight Solution
items.description: A working light the colour of old chalk. It picks out cut channels and worn inlay far better than it lights a road.

effects.description: A flat grey-white light that shows detail rather than distance.

items.name: Annotated Light
items.description: A close, warm reading light that makes ink stand off a page. Useless outdoors and indispensable at a desk.

effects.description: A tight working light that shows writing rather than distance.

items.name: Marginalia Lantern
items.description: Under it, the notes somebody pencilled in a margin twenty years ago and then erased come back faintly. Ione has asked that this not be sold outside the tower.

effects.description: Raises writing that is no longer strictly on the page.

items.name: Channelfire Lantern
items.description: A hard orange working light with the smell of hot stone behind it. It does not flatter anything it shines on and it does not go out.

effects.description: A hot, unflattering light that holds against wind and wet.

items.name: Hearthchannel Lantern
items.description: A kiln geode taken down a hot channel. The light it gives is the colour of a forge at the end of a working day and lasts about as long as one.

effects.description: Burns far longer than a carried light has any business burning.
Keeps the cold out of whoever is working beside it.

items.name: Coldread Solution
items.description: A flat white light with no warmth in it. It flatters nothing and hides nothing, which is the entire requirement when the page you are reading has been lied about.

effects.description: Cold even light that shows a surface exactly as it is.

items.name: Lowstar Lantern
items.description: Warm and unhurried, and it lasts far past the point where a light has any right to. Four hours went into the ash and the lantern gives them back slowly.

effects.description: A patient warm light that outlasts anything else the tower makes.

items.name: Heldstar Lantern
items.description: Lens ash and a shard off the same ring, brewed on the floor directly beneath them. It does not flicker at all. Ione has described looking at it as being looked back at, and then declined to expand on that.

effects.description: A still, unflickering light that lasts most of a working night.
Steadying to sit beside, for reasons nobody has written down.

items.name: Leakfire Flare
items.description: Very bright, very briefly, over a wide area. It was never going to hold its light and this is the version of that fault which is worth carrying.

effects.description: A short wide flare rather than a light you can work by.

items.name: Second Reading
items.description: A dull, patient little light that shows the inside of a bottle rather than the room. Ione has started asking for the failures instead of the successes and will not explain.

effects.description: A close working light for looking at what went wrong.
